comments.text:
Dronacharya was right in saying that Arjun was better than Karan or anyone at that time:

1. Karan was already a part of the Raj Gurukul of Hastinapur as Angdesh was under Hastinapur. Karan's father Adhirath was the charioteer to Bhishma but Karan was also the grand-son to the Satkarma the king of Angdesh. Adhirath never became King because his father was too attacched to the throne and Duryodhan declared Karan as King when Satkarma was becoming very old.
2. Karan and the Kauravas were defeated by Drupad in the Gurudakshina for Dronacharya and the Pandavas led by Arjun had defeated Drupad and freed the Kauravas along with Karan.
3. Karan was unable to learn the Shabdh bhedi vidya; skill of firing at enemies from the sound they make even after seven years of being in Dronacharya's gurukul while Arjun had learnt it on his own within a year of his start of education.
4. After the rang sabha, Arjun had either defeated Karan directly or had defeated opponents that had defeated Karan. Never even once was Arjun ever defeated by anyone.
